title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Public Lighting - Lampara
description: Light source: bulb, LED module or converter of electrical energy into light. Each luminaire houses exactly one lamp (edintalu:Lampara). Includes photometric properties and rated life.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Lampara'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

potenciaNominal.description: Property. Nominal power of the lamp, in watts (edintalu:potenciaNominal). The source expresses this as a qudt:QuantityValue; simplified here to a plain number.

flujoLuminoso.description: Property. Luminous flux of the lamp, in lumens (edintalu:flujoLuminoso). Simplified from a qudt:QuantityValue, as above.

intensidadLuminica.description: Property. Luminous intensity of the lamp, in candelas (edintalu:intensidadLuminica). Simplified from a qudt:QuantityValue, as above.

temperaturaColor.description: Property. Correlated color temperature (CCT) of the lamp, in kelvin (edintalu:temperaturaColor). Simplified from a qudt:QuantityValue, as above.

vidaUtilL70.description: Property. Rated life of the lamp at 70% maintained flux, in hours (edintalu:vidaUtilL70). Simplified from a qudt:QuantityValue, as above.

vidaUtilL80.description: Property. Rated life of the lamp at 80% maintained flux, in hours (edintalu:vidaUtilL80). Simplified from a qudt:QuantityValue, as above.

eficaciaLuminosa.description: Property. Luminous efficacy of the lamp, in lumens per watt (edintalu:eficaciaLuminosa).

indiceReproduccionCromatica.description: Property. Color rendering index (CRI) of the lamp, 0-100 (edintalu:indiceReproduccionCromatica).

fechaInstalacion.description: Property. Installation date of the lamp (edintalu:fechaInstalacion).

modeloBombilla.description: Property. Code or model of the bulb (edintalu:modeloBombilla).
